title: 3-Day Yogurt Shawarma Prep
instructions: Whisk Greek yogurt, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, and all shawarma spices in a bowl.
Coat chicken thighs thoroughly in the marinade.
Refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 3 days for meal prep.
To cook: grill over medium-high heat or sear in a cast-iron skillet for 6-8 minutes per side until charred and internal temp reaches 165°F (74°C).
Slice thinly and serve with rice, tzatziki, and warm pita.
notes: Marinating in Greek yogurt tenderizes the chicken enzymes over 72 hours.
